note: Shared gun feel numbers (D-122). Per-gun numbers are in weapons.json "feel" (kick [pitch, yaw] deg, pattern [[pitch mult, yaw mult], ...] repeating per burst, recover deg/s the view kick returns, bloom [deg per shot, max deg, deg/s back], ads_spread multiplier and ads_zoom while aiming, vm_kick [back m, up m, tilt deg] of the first-person gun, flash size) and "reload_cues" [[fraction of reload_time, sound], ...], "eject" (fire / pump / bolt / reload: when a casing flies out) and "cycle" {at s after the shot, sound} for pump and bolt guns. burst_reset_s: a pause this long starts the recoil pattern again, and only then do the view kick and the spread bloom start recovering. ads_offset: where the first-person gun moves while aiming (m, camera space); ads_speed: how fast it gets there. flash_*: pooled muzzle flashes (quad + light); casing_*: pooled ejected casings (no physics bodies), only within casing_max_m of the camera.
